    count = 0
    # Iterate through the list of characters
    for i in range(len(chars)-1):
        # Check if the two adjacent characters are the same
        if chars[i] == chars[i+1]:
            # If they are the same, increment the counter
            count += 1
    # If the counter is greater than 1, return False
    if count > 1:
        return False
    # If the counter is 1, return True
    else:
        return True

def heap_replace(heap, item):
    # Find the index of the smallest element in the heap
    min_index = 0
    for i in range(1, len(heap)):
        if heap[i] < heap[min_index]:
            min_index = i
    # Replace the smallest element with the new item
    heap[min_index] = item
    # Heapify the new item
    heapify(heap, min_index)
    return heap

def heapify(heap, index):
    # Get the left child
    left_child = 2 * index + 1
    # Get the right child
    right_child = 2 * index + 2
    # If the left child is greater than the right child
    if left_child < len(heap):
        # If the left child is smaller than the right child
        if heap[left_child] > heap[right_child]:
            # Swap the left child with the right child
            heap[left_child], heap[right_child] = heap[right_child], heap[left_child]
        # Recurse
        heapify(heap, left_child)
    else:
        # If the left child is greater than the right child
        heap[index] = heap[left_child]
        # Recurse
        heapify(heap, left_child)

def set_Bit_Number(n):
    # Initialize the most significant bit number
    most_significant_bit = 0
    # Iterate through the bits of the number
    while n > 0:
        # Check if the most significant bit is set
        if n & 1 == 1:
            # If it is, set the most significant bit
            most_significant_bit = 1
        # Shift the number to the right
        n >>= 1
    return most_significant_bit
